title.zh: 5月19日晚廣場學生宣布停止絕食改為靜坐
title.en: Night of 19 May: students in the Square announce end of hunger strike, shifting to a sit-in

summary.zh: 5 月 19 日凌晨，中共中央總書記趙紫陽曾到廣場探望並勸說學生停止絕食。當晚九時許，在連日絕食與戒嚴傳聞交織之下，廣場學生廣播宣布停止絕食，改為靜坐請願；然而數小時後當局隨即正式宣布戒嚴。
summary.en: After CCP General Secretary Zhao Ziyang visited the Square before dawn on 19 May to plead with students to stop fasting, student broadcasts at the Square around 9 p.m. announced the end of the hunger strike in favor of a peaceful sit-in—just hours before martial law was declared.
